This '''anti-Imperial organization''' refers to a resistance group started by [[Elscol Loro]]. Loro and her partner, [[Sixtus Quin]], targeted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]-controlled [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and helped local planetary resistance movements overthrow Imperial control. They trained the local citizens to stage successful uprisings and participated directly in the fighting themselves, but only if the native population were willing to fight. Loro claimed that her team had helped liberate dozens of worlds. The group was recruited by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to overthrow [[Ysanne Isard]]'s control of the [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]-producing world [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] during the [[Bacta War]].
